Solutions
Semiconductor industry
The semiconductor industry is the cornerstone of modern information technology, with its core being the manufacturing of integrated circuits (chips) based on materials such as silicon. It connects upstream materials, equipment, and design, midstream wafer manufacturing, packaging testing, and downstream end applications such as consumer electronics, automotive, communication, and industrial control. This industry is technology intensive and capital intensive, following the famous "Moore's Law" and pursuing the integration of more transistors per unit area to improve performance and reduce power consumption. Currently, the global semiconductor industry is undergoing profound changes, with fierce competition in advanced processes and a clear trend towards regionalization of the industry chain. At the same time, emerging applications such as artificial intelligence, 5G, and the Internet of Things are driving a new round of innovation and growth.
3C electronics industry
Glue dispensing machine is an automated machine specialized in controlling fluids, which can meet the development needs of high-precision, high-efficiency, high-quality, and intelligent automation production in multiple fields. Our servo system can help achieve more precise positioning and higher precision in dispensing operations.
Lithium battery industry
Lithium batteries have special discrete production characteristics and require precise docking of material racks, which places high demands on the reliability, stability, and high-precision control of equipment in the pre -, mid -, and post manufacturing processes. We can provide high-performance servo systems to enable production equipment to achieve efficient, stable, and high-precision manufacturing.
Laser industry
The equipment used in the laser industry often has high flexibility, fast cutting speed, high production efficiency, and high processing accuracy. We can provide a complete set of servo systems for laser cutting machines to improve cutting processes, enhance cutting accuracy, and improve equipment efficiency.
Robotics industry
A high-performance servo system is a key element in helping robots improve production efficiency. The high-tech servo solution has the characteristics of high efficiency, high speed, and high precision, suitable for application scenarios such as loading and unloading, precision assembly, handling, dispensing, and coating.
Photovoltaic industry
The overall demand for servo systems in photovoltaic equipment is high, with a large number of axes and fast response time requirements. We can provide high-speed and high-precision control servo system solutions, which can be used in equipment such as screen printing machines and coating machines.
